## Parquet Penguins Demo with PySpark

This demo shows how to work with the Palmer Penguins dataset using PySpark and Apache Parquet format.

```{python}
# Import required libraries
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

# Create Spark session with the appName ParquetPenguinsDemo
spark = SparkSession.builder \
    .appName("ParquetPenguinsDemo") \
    .master("local[*]") \
    .getOrCreate()

# Load the penguins dataset
penguins_pandas = load_penguins()

# Create a Spark DataFrame from the pandas DataFrame
penguins_df = spark.createDataFrame(penguins_pandas)

# Drop all NA values
penguins_cleaned = penguins_df.dropna()

# Show the top 10 rows
print("Top 10 rows of the cleaned penguins dataset:")
penguins_cleaned.show(10)

# Show the schema
print("\nSchema of the penguins DataFrame:")
penguins_cleaned.printSchema()

# Stop the Spark session
spark.stop()
```
